itens.trecho: Vencedor do "Urso de Prata" - Prêmio do Júri Ecumênico e Prêmio do Júri de Leitores do Berliner Morgenpost no 75º Festival Internacional de Cinema de Berlim (2025).

The Brazilian government has concluded that the best way to care for their elderly population is to send them all to a colony when they reach eighty. "Tereza" (Denise Weinberg) is a mere seventy-seven when she gets the call up - and she's not remotely interested in wearing a nappy for the rest of her life. She has plans. She wants to fly a plane.
